mn123:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn123:2.1: atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
mn123:2.2: acchariyaṃ āvuso abbhūtaṃ āvuso tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvakatā
mn123:2.3: yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jānissati
mn123:2.4: evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi evaṃnāmā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi evaṃgottā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi evaṃsīlā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi evaṃdhammā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi evaṃpaññā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi evaṃvihārī te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti.
mn123:2.5: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando te bhikkhū etadavoca
mn123:2.6: acchariyā ceva āvuso tathāgatā acchariyadhammasamannāgatā ca
mn123:2.7: abbhūtā ceva āvuso tathāgatā abbhūtadhammasamannāgatā cāti.
mn123:2.8: ayañca hidaṃ tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ayaṃ antarākathā vippakatā hoti.
mn123:2.9: atha bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenupaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn123:2.11: kāya nuttha bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatāti.
mn123:2.12: idha bhante amhākaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
mn123:2.13: acchariyaṃ āvuso abbhūtaṃ āvuso tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvakatā yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jānissati
mn123:2.14: evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi evaṃnāmā … evaṃgottā … evaṃsīlā … evaṃdhammā … evaṃpaññā … evaṃvihārī … evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti evaṃ vutte bhante āyasmā ānando amhe etadavoca
mn123:2.15: acchariyā ceva āvuso tathāgatā acchariyadhammasamannāgatā ca
mn123:2.16: abbhūtā ceva āvuso tathāgatā abbhūtadhammasamannāgatā cāti
mn123:2.17: ayaṃ kho no bhante antarākathā vippakatā atha bhagavā anuppattoti.
mn123:2.18: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
mn123:2.19: tasmātiha taṃ ānanda bhiyyoso mattāya paṭibhantu tathāgatassa acchariyā abbhūtadhammāti.
mn123:3.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:3.2: sato sampajāno ānanda bodhisatto tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajjīti.
mn123:3.3: yampi bhante sato sampajāno bodhisatto tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajji idaṃpahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:4.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:4.2: sato sampajāno ānanda bodhisatto tusite kāye aṭṭhāsīti.
mn123:4.3: yampi bhante sato sampajāno bodhisatto tusite kāye aṭṭhāsi idaṃpahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:5.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:5.2: yāvatāyukaṃ ānanda bodhisatto tusite kāye aṭṭhāsīti.
mn123:5.3: yampi bhante yāvatāyukaṃ bodhisatto tusite kāye aṭṭhāsi idaṃpahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:6.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:6.2: sato sampajāno ānanda bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātu kucchiṃ okkamīti.
mn123:6.3: yampi bhante sato sampajāno bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātu kucchiṃ okkami idaṃpahaṃ bhante …pe… dhāremi.
mn123:7.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:7.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātu kucchiṃ okkamati
mn123:7.3: atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo oḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ
mn123:7.4: yāpi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā yatthapime candimasuriyā evaṃmahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti tatthapi appamāṇo oḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ
mn123:7.5: yepi tattha sattā upapannā tepi tenobhāsena aññamaññassa jānanti aññepi kira bho santi sattā idhūpapannāti
mn123:7.6: ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati appamāṇo ca oḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvanti.
mn123:7.7: yampi bhante …pe… idaṃpahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:8.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:8.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti cattāro naṃ devaputtā catuddisārakkhāya upagacchanti mā naṃ bodhisattaṃ vā bodhisattamātaraṃ vā manusso vā amanusso vā koci vā vihesesīti.
mn123:8.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:9.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:9.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti pakatiyā sīlavatī bodhisattamātā hoti viratā pāṇātipātā viratā adinnādānā viratā kāmesumicchācārā viratā musāvādā viratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānāti.
mn123:9.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:10.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:10.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti na bodhisattamātu purisesu mānasaṃ uppajjati kāmaguṇopasañhitaṃ anatikkamaniyā ca bodhisattamātā hoti kenaci purisena rattacittenāti.
mn123:10.3: yampi bhante …pe… bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:11.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:11.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti lābhinī bodhisattamātā hoti pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ sā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāretīti.
mn123:11.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:12.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:12.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ ahinindriyaṃ.
mn123:12.3: seyyathāpi ānanda maṇi veḷuriyo subho jotimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato. tatrassa suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitakaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā.
mn123:12.4: tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jotimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato. tatridaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitakaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vāti
mn123:12.5: evameva kho ānanda yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ ahinindriyanti.
mn123:12.6: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:13.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:13.2: sattāhaṃ jāte ānanda bodhisatte bodhisattamātā kālaṃ karoti tusitakāyaṃ upapajjatīti.
mn123:13.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:14.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:14.2: yathā kho panānanda aññā itthikā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyanti na hevaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati daseva māsāni bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyatīti.
mn123:14.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:15.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:15.2: yathā kho panānanda aññā itthikā nisinnā vā nipannā vā vijāyanti na hevaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati ṭhitāva bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyatīti.
mn123:15.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:16.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:16.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchimhā nikkhamati devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti pacchā manussāti.
mn123:16.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:17.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:17.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchimhā nikkhamati appattova bodhisatto paṭhaviṃ hoti cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu puratova ṭhapenti attamanā devī hotu mahesakkho te putto uppannoti.
mn123:17.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:18.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:18.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchimhā nikkhamati atha visuddhova nikkhamati amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito pubbena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visuddho.
mn123:18.3: seyyathāpi ānanda maṇiratanaṃ kāsikavatthe nikkhittaṃ neva maṇiratanaṃ kāsikavatthaṃ makkheti nāpi kāsikavatthaṃ maṇiratanaṃ makkheti
mn123:18.6: evameva kho ānanda yadā bodhisatto mātu kucchimhā nikkhamati visuddho nikkhamati amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena …pe… amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visuddhoti.
mn123:18.7: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:19.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:19.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchimhā nikkhamati dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti ekā sītassa ekā uṇhassa yena bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karoti mātu cāti.
mn123:19.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:20.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:20.2: sampatijāto ānanda bodhisatto samehi pādehi paṭhaviyaṃ patiṭṭhahitvā uttarābhimukho sattapadavītihārena gacchati setamhi chatte anuhīramāne sabbā ca disā viloketi āsabhiñca vācaṃ bhāsati aggohamasmi lokassa jeṭṭhohamasmi lokassa seṭṭhohamasmi lokassa ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
mn123:20.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:21.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
mn123:21.2: yadā ānanda bodhisatto mātu kucchimhā nikkhamati atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo oḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ
mn123:21.3: yāpi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā yatthapime candimasuriyā evaṃmahiddhikā evaṃmahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti tatthapi appamāṇo oḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ
mn123:21.4: yepi tattha sattā upapannā tepi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti aññepi kira bho santi sattā idhūpapannāti
mn123:21.5: ayaṃ kho dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati appamāṇo ca oḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvanti.
mn123:21.6: yampi bhante …pe… idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremīti.
mn123:22.1: tasmātiha tvaṃ ānanda idampi tathāgatassa acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhārehīti.
mn123:22.2: idhānanda tathāgatassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti
mn123:22.4: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn123:22.5: idampi kho tvaṃ ānanda tathāgatassa acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhārehīti.
mn123:23.1: yampi bhante bhagavato viditā vedanā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn123:23.3: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn123:23.4: idampahaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ dhāremīti.
mn123:23.7: attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
